name: Vasaniwebinfotech Anti-Spam Shield for Elementor
author: vasanikevin2016

sections.description:
Vasaniwebinfotech Anti-Spam Shield for Elementor is a lightweight yet powerful security solution designed to block automated bots, fake leads, disposable email addresses, and spam link submissions on Elementor Forms in real-time.

Key Features

  • Real-Time Live Validation: Validates form inputs on keyup before the form is even submitted.
  • Disposable Email Blocker: Restricts temporary and burner email domains automatically.
  • Prohibit Links & URLs: Blocks submission of website URLs and backlinks inside standard text and message fields.
  • Keyword Filter: Easily configure global forbidden keywords (e.g. casino, crypto, seo).
  • Layer-3 Bot Protection: Includes a non-intrusive honeypot trap to catch automated submitters.
  • Direct API Protection: Blocks unauthorized direct POST requests bypassing the frontend interface.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the vwi-anti-spam-shield directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings > Anti-Spam Shield in your WordPress admin menu to configure your form field selectors and security rules.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes, this plugin is designed specifically to enhance and protect Elementor Forms.

How do I target my Elementor Form?

You can simply use the standard CSS selector like form.elementor-form or pass a custom CSS ID assigned to your form widget.
